prose.title: Shawn Blake Beat the Entire Field. The Preseason {{f.pre.0004.power_rank}} Beat No One.
prose.dek: Bear Dunn and Derrick Whitman lead their divisions, both preseason top-two picks are already searching for answers, and Eric Mannila's whole lineup no-showed on the same Sunday.

desk.speaker: stuart
desk.text: Welcome back to UPS Center. Week two, and we have to start with the only man who beat the entire field: {{f.week.perfect}}. That is {{f.wire.record_team_score}}. Rich?

desk.speaker: rich
desk.text: Thanks, Stu. And it was not a fluke off one big offensive week either. Blake's defense put up {{f.team.0010.idp_pts}} -- {{f.team.0010.idp_rank}}. Devin Lloyd alone: {{f.star.idp.line}}, good for {{f.star.idp.score}} points.

desk.speaker: stuart
desk.text: And on offense, {{f.star.name}}. {{f.star.line}}. {{f.star.score}} points for {{f.star.owner}}. By expected points: {{f.xfp.over.4}}. That is a complete team, top to bottom.

desk.speaker: rich
desk.text: Now go to the other end of the same Sunday, Stu. {{f.week.winless}} lost to the entire field. {{f.week.bust_1}}. Backup work, in real time.

desk.speaker: stuart
desk.text: {{f.week.bust_2}}. Same owner, same day. Mannila's whole bench call is in the burn column too, further down this recap. Bad Sunday, not a bad Saturday-night call.

desk.speaker: rich
desk.text: But somebody's usage WAS the real thing, Stu. {{f.bb.off.bargain.1}}. Look at the workload: {{f.bb.off.bargain.1.xfp}}. That is volume, not luck.

desk.speaker: stuart
desk.text: Furthest over expected in the whole league: {{f.xfp.over.1}}. Furthest under: {{f.xfp.under.1}}. That is a bargain and a bust on the same expected-points ruler, Rich.

desk.speaker: rich
desk.text: On defense, the bargain was {{f.bb.idp.bargain.1}}. The bust: {{f.bb.idp.bust.1}}. Five of each, offense and defense, every one measured against MFL's own last projection.

desk.speaker: stuart
desk.text: And a word of warning before anybody trusts a bust-bargain list too far, Rich: {{f.bb.unranked}}. If a name is missing from these tables, that is why -- not because the week did not happen for him.

desk.speaker: rich
desk.text: Now the podium. Top scorer in the league: {{f.star.name}}, {{f.star.owner}}. Right behind him by expected points: {{f.xfp.over.1}}.

desk.speaker: stuart
desk.text: Two quarterbacks and a receiver round out the top five this week. Whatever you drafted your roster around, week two did not care.

captions.t.offidp: Shawn Blake's week, broken down: the most IDP points in the league sitting on top of a five-touchdown quarterback game.
captions.t.performers: Two quarterbacks and a Seattle receiver at the top of the board.

desk.speaker: stuart
desk.text: Two divisions crossed over against each other this week, Rich -- every owner in one division played all three in the other. Nine games apiece. Let's go division by division, because both of them broke completely differently.

desk.speaker: rich
desk.text: They did, Stu. One preseason favorite swept his crossover. The other preseason favorite did not win a single game in it.

p.1.speaker: stuart
p.1.text: Legion of Boom against Outlast PG Time, and the headline is {{f.week.perfect}}, who beat the entire field. Nine wins in nine games would have been the whole story if the other side of this crossover had not also collapsed.

p.1.speaker: rich
p.1.text: Because the preseason favorite here was {{f.pot.legion-of-boom-v-outlast-pg-time.favorite}}, and {{f.pot.legion-of-boom-v-outlast-pg-time.favorite_result}}. Zero wins against three different opponents.

p.1.speaker: stuart
p.1.text: And the reason is sitting right there in the burn column, Rich. {{f.burn.owner}} benched {{f.burn.benched}} for {{f.burn.started}}, and {{f.burn.covers_margin}}. That is on tape, before either game kicked off.

p.1.speaker: rich
p.1.text: On the flip side of this same crossover: {{f.week.won_on_defense}} -- outscored on offense, and it did not matter, because {{f.pot.legion-of-boom-v-outlast-pg-time.idp_pts}} points came out of that defense across the whole crossover.

p.1.speaker: stuart
p.1.text: And the preseason longshot on this side of the bracket: {{f.pot.legion-of-boom-v-outlast-pg-time.longshot}}, and {{f.pot.legion-of-boom-v-outlast-pg-time.longshot_result}}. Nine games, three winners, and the man ranked last of the four beat every single one of them.

p.1.speaker: rich
p.1.text: Book-ended by a perfect week and a shutout, and the preseason order had it exactly backwards. That is week two for you.

p.2.speaker: stuart
p.2.text: DOG POUND 4 LIFE against Maddie Mondays, and the favorite held. {{f.pot.dog-pound-4-life-v-maddie-mondays.favorite}}, and {{f.pot.dog-pound-4-life-v-maddie-mondays.favorite_result}} -- every game, across the whole crossover.

p.2.speaker: rich
p.2.text: His best player: {{f.pot.dog-pound-4-life-v-maddie-mondays.best_player}}. His best defender: {{f.pot.dog-pound-4-life-v-maddie-mondays.best_idp}}. That is a complete week from the top of the preseason board, no surprises.

p.2.speaker: stuart
p.2.text: Except he was not alone at the top, Rich. {{f.pot.dog-pound-4-life-v-maddie-mondays.sweeper}} both went through this crossover unbeaten -- one of them the preseason {{f.pre.0009.power_rank}}, the other the preseason {{f.pre.0012.power_rank}}.

p.2.speaker: rich
p.2.text: And the preseason longshot in this crossover, {{f.pot.dog-pound-4-life-v-maddie-mondays.longshot}}, {{f.pot.dog-pound-4-life-v-maddie-mondays.longshot_result}} -- one better than his preseason number would have called for, and nowhere near the trouble at the very bottom of this same crossover.

p.2.speaker: stuart
p.2.text: Because at the very bottom, {{f.pot.dog-pound-4-life-v-maddie-mondays.winless}}. Same owner we already talked about with the backup quarterback -- the whole week fell apart at once, and this is where it shows up on the ledger.

p.2.speaker: rich
p.2.text: Between the two crossovers, this one put up {{f.pot.dog-pound-4-life-v-maddie-mondays.points_rank}}. Fewer fireworks, same story underneath: the team on top looked the part, and everybody else scrapped for the other spots.

p.2.speaker: stuart
p.2.text: Two crossovers, two different shapes -- one blown wide open at the top, one that went almost exactly to the preseason script. Rich Eisen, Stuart Scott, back after this.

desk.speaker: stuart
desk.text: Four divisions, four leaders: {{f.div.outlast-pg-time.leader}}, {{f.div.dog-pound-4-life.leader}}, {{f.div.maddie-mondays.leader}} and {{f.div.legion-of-boom.leader}}. Two games into the season, and Derrick Whitman is the only one of the four without a loss.

desk.speaker: rich
desk.text: He came in {{f.pre.0002.power_rank}} in the preseason, Stu. Now he owns the best record in the league, and the week's own preview graded him a favorite and got it right: {{f.grade.g3.result}}.

desk.speaker: stuart
desk.text: Speaking of the preview grade, Rich, the model has some explaining to do: {{f.grade.favorites}}, and {{f.grade.brier}}.

desk.speaker: rich
desk.text: Rough week for the model, Stu, but look at WHY before you pile on. {{f.grade.g2.result}}, and the injury report flipped on him after the cutoff: {{f.grade.g2.flip}}. That is not the model's fault -- that is Sunday football.

desk.speaker: stuart
desk.text: Fair, Rich. And overall, {{f.grade.injuries}} on the injury watch. {{f.grade.ranges}} -- so most of the board landed right where it was supposed to, one week did not.

desk.speaker: rich
desk.text: Now the one that will not go away, Stu -- the bench call. {{f.burn.owner}} sat {{f.burn.benched}} for {{f.burn.started}}, and {{f.burn.covers_margin}}. Neither player's decision is on the record either way -- {{f.burn.verdict}}.

desk.speaker: stuart
desk.text: That one will follow him into next week's Coffee Shop no matter what the record book says about it, Rich.

desk.speaker: rich
desk.text: It is week two of fourteen. Nobody's playoff picture is written in ink -- ask Bear Dunn, ranked first all preseason and still finding his footing, or Matt Gerardi, ranked last and sweeping a division. Rich Eisen, Stuart Scott, that is UPS Center.

captions.t.standings: Division winners take the top two seeds; all-play orders everybody else.
captions.t.preseason: The preseason order against two weeks of football. Read it for fun, not for betting.
captions.t.burns: The week's headline bench call -- neither player's decision is graded; see the note.
